name: Enguera (Spain)
description: Yellow field charged at the centre with a white castle bearing the letters QSD, between two red crosses of Saint James.
history: The flag, approved on 24 January 2008 and published in the Diario Oficial de la Comunidad Valenciana of 11 February 2008, is of proportions 2:3, yellow, with a castle of silver or pearl grey masoned and pierced sable and above it the initials QSD for Saint Michael, patron of the town, with a red cross of Saint James on either side. The arms had been published in the Boletín Oficial del Estado of 20 September 1973.

features.role: castle masoned and pierced black with the letters QSD
two crosses of Saint James flanking the castle
masonry and openings of the castle
